text_block_list.text:
One night, just before the spring GⅠ 
season was about to begin, Mejiro Ryan was 
feeling lost and troubled over her future 
goals.

Listening closely to what she had to say, 
the Trainer guided her to look into the 
true desires deep within her heart.

Facing her true feelings, Mejiro Ryan 
realized that she wanted to become a "Star 
Umamusume" just like Mejiro McQueen and 
the others.

Mejiro Ryan still possesses an immature 
heart. Yet, even harboring such fragility, 
she has begun running toward a grueling 
spring.
